children: State-owned Kuwait Petroleum Corporation (KPC) and its subsidiaries opened 27 tenders during the last week of August, according to the local press.

The tenders covered works and services in the drilling and production sectors, wellhead equipment and control systems, and unconventional reservoir services, the Arabic language daily Al-Rai said, citing KPC sources.

The highest bids submitted in the top 10 tenders totaled around 127.9 million Kuwaiti dinars ($414 million). The wellhead equipment and control and monitoring systems tender had the highest bid at KWD59 million, while the lowest bid among the 15 companies that submitted bids was KWD45.5 million.
In the tender for the Schlumberger [SLB] technology provision contract, the company's final bid was KWD19.9 million, the report said.
This was the eighth revision, opened on 25 August, after the original bid submitted in June was KWD 46.8 million.
“The company thus reduced its bid in this tender by nearly KWD 26.84 million, or around 57 percent of its original value,” the paper added.
(Writing by N Saeed; Editing by Anoop Menon)
